userAvatarRule.rule: The user/CEO is never rendered as a face. Use only a dotted, faceless, royal-outline silhouette.

displayRule.staff: Display staff as "{title}, {firstName}" only. Archetype ids are internal and must not be shown.
displayRule.ceoHonorific: Dialogue addresses the user with a configurable CEO honorific. Default is "대표님" for Korean locale and "Mr. CEO" for English/non-Korean locale.
displayRule.legacyCeoAgent: If imported or seeded agent data contains a CEO agent, Kawaii UI treats that staff visual as CTO. The real CEO is always the signed-in user.

sceneCompositePolicy.rule: Use finished character-in-scene composites for large stage presentation.
sceneCompositePolicy.generationRule: Input the approved sourceCharacter image and generate a 1536x1024 scene with the character integrated into the background.
sceneCompositePolicy.placementRule: Character center at 76% canvas width, body height 82-90%, head top 5-10%, feet 92-97%, right margin at least 4%, left 58% remains UI-safe.

dialogueCutinPolicy.rule: Use background-removed waist-up cut-ins for the lower-right dialogue dock.
dialogueCutinPolicy.generationRule: Input the approved sourceCharacter image and generate a PNG cut-in without a scene background, card, or border.
dialogueCutinPolicy.placementRule: Head, hair, shoulders, hands, and key role accessory remain visible; crop ends around the waist or upper abdomen, with no legs visible.
